children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Route player connections through an external relay when you lack a public IP, port-forwarding, or a cluster load balancer. A tunnel layers over the server's backing Service; it is not a fifth expose mode. Use it only when direct exposure is unavailable.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Tunnels add operational cost. Each tunnel-enabled server gets its own always-on tunnel pod to hold the public address, even while the game sleeps.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Use a tunnel when you lack a public IP, port-forwarding, or cluster load balancer access—but not if you already have a working LoadBalancer or public IP.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use when behind CGNAT or restrictive ISP

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Use when LoadBalancer is not an option

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Do not use if you already have public IP and working port-forwarding

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Three relay providers are supported: frp for production, Tailscale for private networks, and playit.gg for casual testing.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use frp for production servers with custom public domains

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Use Tailscale for private play on your tailnet (free, no VPS)

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Use playit.gg for free public relay and quick testing

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Set credentials via dashboard (recommended), API, or kubectl with proper ownerReferences. The tunnel pod connects and serves players even while the game sleeps.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Prepare relay credentials (frp token, Tailscale key, or playit secret)

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Create GameServer with tunnel enabled and provider configured

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Provide credentials via dashboard; verify TunnelReady condition
